_note: Manual log of title/meta-description CTR edits, keyed by page path. Purpose: stop check_ctr_watch.py from re-flagging a page as broken before an edit has had time to register in Search Console (needs ~21+ days of real impression volume), and stop us from re-trying a wording that already failed. Append a new entry to a page's 'edits' array every time you commit a CTR-motivated title/meta change - date, commit, and a one-line summary of what changed. Seeded 2026-09-04 from git history; keep it current by hand, same discipline as WORKING_PREFERENCES.md.

Root cause found via live Google SERP screenshot (query: 'golf son gual mallorca reviews'): every competitor around our result (Leading Courses, Golfshake, Top 100 Golf Courses, Golf in Spain) shows a star-rating/review-count rich snippet; ours shows plain text. URL Inspection confirms our Review schema is technically valid and eligible, but Google's guidelines explicitly withhold star-snippet display for a business's own self-authored review of itself (vs. genuine third-party aggregator reviews, which is what every competitor here is). This is not a title/meta problem and cannot be fixed by rewriting copy - do not attempt another title round on this basis. Only real fix would be getting listed/reviewed on a third-party aggregator, which is outside site code.
